metadata.source_isolation: all compiled Swift source bytes copied into retained BUILD_DIR/source before compilation

method.first_window: new controller and new NSHostingView/NSPanel per sample, same process; OS/framework caches remain warm; not OS cold start
method.intermediate_timestamps: readiness_candidate_ms is first input/Markdown evidence regardless of fade; interaction_ready_ms additionally waits for a subsequent didUpdate; fully_visible_candidate_ms requires interaction readiness and alphaValue >= 0.99; final elapsed_ms rechecks every condition on the next consecutive probe. Content-update evidence precedes the fade threshold: no extra didUpdate is required after fade completion because AppKit does not guarantee one
method.limits: controller-dispatch to UI readiness with the 0.99 window-alpha threshold; excludes hardware input/hotkey routing, OS launch, AI network/streaming and GPU/compositor scanout; no FPS claim
method.observer: same-process AX queries; measured probe overhead remains included in elapsed_ms and is reported separately; no forced focus/layout/display
method.percentile: nearest-rank ceil(p*n)-1; only emitted for a complete group
method.quick_endpoint: visible/unoccluded key panel, editable PlaceholderTextView firstResponder; insertText accepted by editor and model, then a subsequent NSWindow didUpdate; final elapsed_ms requires all input evidence plus alphaValue >= 0.99 on two consecutive probes
method.result_endpoint: visible/unoccluded panel; exact rendered heading plus Markdown-only code-copy button have nonempty AX frames fully inside actual scroll viewport, then a subsequent NSWindow didUpdate; final elapsed_ms requires all Markdown evidence plus alphaValue >= 0.99 on two consecutive probes
method.reused_window: one excluded first-show warmup then reopen the same controller/window/hosting tree and same completed Markdown
method.start: immediately before the real controller.show(); models/controllers and completed fixture are prepared beforehand
